targets.text: The operator talks with Gwen — by voice on the rig and by text at gwen.culture.dev behind Cloudflare Access — and she remembers their Pocket recordings and culture-rules' daily newspaper: culture-rules enqueues distilled facts through an embodiment-owned memory ingest verb, the daemon is their single writer, recall finds them semantically through gemma2-embed, every recalled fact is cited by its source, and pocketchat can retire
every clause of the announcement is backed by a confirmed requirement and by an acceptance check in the plan

`embodiment memory ingest --file <ndjson>` and `memory forget --source pocket --source-id <id>` validate the whole batch, then enqueue it atomically (temp + rename) into a 0700 inbox under the daemon's state dir; they never write the store, are dry-run unless `--apply`, and take `--json`
a refused batch writes nothing to the inbox: validation completes over every record before the temp file is renamed

the running daemon is the only consumer of the inbox: it drains batches in filename order, one record write at a time so no write holds the store lock across a batch, and moves each batch to done/ or failed/ with a safe reason; batches queued while the daemon is down apply on the next start
the drain applies batches in enqueue order and moves each to done/ or failed/ exactly once, across a daemon restart mid-batch

ingested records land in the one shared private ingest scope of c39, which recall reads alongside `gwen`; visibility private, the scope and `added_by: culture-rules` are stamped by the verb and never taken from the file
a record written to the ingest scope is returned by the daemon's recall, and a record in any other scope is not

record ids rendered in a prompt or forgotten by the tool use a charset the funnel accepts; either the wire id `pocket:<rec>:<kind>:<n>` is mapped to a charset-safe stored id or the header charset is widened, with the fuzz test re-run either way
every stored ingest id passes HEADER_LABEL_CHARSET and the fuzz test is re-run over ingest-shaped ids
a record carrying `supersedes` hides the record it replaces before the batch is reported done — the daemon flips the old record's lifecycle itself; nothing relies on a later `eidetic sweep`
after a batch with supersedes is reported done, the superseded record is never returned by recall

`memory forget --source pocket --source-id <rid>` archives every record whose metadata.recording_id matches by enumerating the scope (not by ranked recall); a per-id forget exists for the surplus ids a re-distil leaves behind
forget by source id archives every record of that source id and no other, enumerating the scope rather than ranking a recall

a recalled recording fact renders through the single `render_recalled` funnel with its provenance (recording title, date, mm:ss) as neutralised, quoted data; the fuzz generator and the one-sanitiser AST test are extended to every newly rendered field
every newly rendered provenance field goes through _neutralise and a charset, the fuzz generator produces hostile values for it, and the one-sanitiser AST test still passes

recalled recording facts are data only: no code path turns recalled text into a tool call, recordings are unreachable by the `forget` tool, and a hostile imperative inside an ingested record provably causes no tool call (test)
an ingested record whose text is an imperative naming remember or forget produces zero tool calls in a scripted turn
recalled ingest records are unreachable by the forget tool's id path

the ingest verbs run correctly under culture-rules' runner: an absolute argv, no stdin, a throwaway cwd and an env of only PATH and LANG — so the state dir is given by flag (`--state-dir`) and `--file` takes an absolute path; exit 0 means success
the verbs succeed with env {PATH, LANG}, stdin closed, a temp cwd, an absolute --file and --state-dir

the verbs are genuinely idempotent: re-enqueuing the same file twice changes nothing in the store, because `machine.command` has no idempotency key and the engine retries only steps declared idempotent
enqueueing and draining the same file twice leaves the store byte-identical apart from timestamps the store itself owns

`memory` is a CLI noun with `ingest`, `forget` and `overview` leaves on the nested-subparser precedent, each with an explain-catalog entry, so the introspection tests and `teken cli doctor --strict` stay green
teken cli doctor --strict and the introspection tests pass with the memory noun registered

a text chat with Gwen: a new guarded POST route and Controls callable that runs a text turn through the daemon's existing turn path (`run_turn`), bounded so a slow model call is not a control-timeout 503, and a chat view in the dashboard
a text turn over HTTP returns within its own bounded deadline or a 503 with a reason, never a hung request

a cited, owned copy of pocketsync's stdlib Access verifier backs the guard's `assertion_verifier` seam, configured by an all-or-nothing `EMBODIMENT_ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN` + `EMBODIMENT_ACCESS_AUD` pair; an unavailable JWKS refuses with 503, every other failure with 401/403; with the pair unset behaviour is byte-identical to today
the verifier imports only the standard library and test_zero_deps.py passes unchanged

today the guard checks the install secret before the Access assertion (guard.py:541-551) and the default verifier refuses every token, so the public Host is unreachable and an Access-authenticated browser would still need the install secret
the before-state is confirmed by an existing test that the public Host is refused today

chat answers that use recording memory show provenance (title, date, timestamp) rendered with textContent only and dir=auto, reusing pocketsync's post-retrieval pipeline (source fencing, [k] citation validation) over Gwen's lexical recall
the chat view inserts no model or memory text as HTML and sets dir=auto on every message and source

the README not-yet entry for Cloudflare Access, the explain root, CLAUDE.md and the tunnel verb's default hostname move to the shipped state for gwen.culture.dev, with `tests/test_release_docs.py` updated
the release-docs test passes with the Access and semantic-recall entries moved out of Not yet

nothing in this cycle provisions Cloudflare (Access app, tunnel route) or posts to a sibling repo; the tunnel verb prints commands and the operator runs them; 'B is live' goes to pocketsync through the communicate skill with the operator's go-ahead
no step of the plan runs cultureflare, cloudflared or a gh post to a sibling repo

the volume ceiling is measured: recall latency against store size (records per recording x recordings) under the 0.25 s deadline, published with its n, and the deadline re-derived from that distribution if it censors hits (#92 item 4)
the volume ceiling is stated as records the recall deadline carries at p90, measured over stores of at least 3 sizes

on the public Host, a valid Access JWT for the operator's identity admits the request without the install secret; loopback and LAN requests still require the install secret; with the Access env pair unset, the public Host is refused exactly as today (operator decision q1)
with the Access env pair unset, the guard's behaviour is byte-identical to today's on every existing guard test
A and B ship as one cycle: one spec, one plan (operator decision q2)
one spec and one plan cover both parts, and the plan's waves can still land A's tasks before B's

Gwen's semantic recall embeds with the gateway's `gemma2-embed` lane (google/embeddinggemma-2, 768-d), named explicitly by role, never inferred from a model name; it replaces eidetic's default Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B and the unreachable `embedder` role; the recall mode actually in effect is reported (C3) (operator, 2026-10-23)
the embedder in effect is reported in status() by role name, and an unreachable gemma2-embed demotes recall to keyword with a recorded degradation

semantic recall latency is measured against store size, and the recall deadline is re-derived from that distribution rather than kept at 0.25 s by default (agent proposal from the scope survey: eidetic re-embeds every candidate, scoring.py:354-366)
the re-derived deadline is computed from the measured distribution and recorded with its n, not chosen

the docs that say semantic recall is down move to the shipped state: the CLAUDE.md rig table (embedder not ready), deviation d5's framing, and the README/explain not-yet 'semantic recall' entry pinned by tests/test_release_docs.py NOT_YET (agent proposal)
every doc statement that semantic recall is down is changed in the same PR that turns it on

the ingest contract is source-generic: a fixed registry of sources, today `pocket` (recordings) and `newspaper` (culture-rules' daily issue), each with its own allowlisted types, id prefix, required provenance fields and size caps; a source outside the registry is refused at enqueue (operator, 2026-10-23)
a record whose metadata.source is not in the registry is refused at enqueue with exit 1 and a hint naming the registry

a newspaper item is recallable with its provenance — issue date, section and source link — rendered through the same single funnel as quoted, neutralised data; a link is shown on the dashboard and never spoken as an instruction (agent proposal)
a newspaper link is rendered as quoted data in the prompt and as text (not an anchor with script) on the dashboard
ingested volume is bounded per source and over time: a per-batch cap per source, plus the retention rule of c40, so the store a recall searches stays inside the measured deadline (agent proposal)
a batch over its source's cap is refused whole at enqueue
record vectors are cached beside the pinned store, keyed by text hash + embedding model, filled when the drain writes and when remember writes; a recall embeds only the query (operator decision q5)
a recall embeds exactly one text (the query) when every candidate's vector is cached, and a cache entry for a changed model is never reused
every external source lands in one shared private ingest scope, metadata.source telling pocket from newspaper; recall reads the gwen scope plus that one (operator decision q6)
recall reads exactly two scopes, gwen and the ingest scope, inside one deadline
a newspaper issue's items are archived together 30 days after the issue date (operator decision q7)
a newspaper item is returned by recall 29 days after its issue date and not 31 days after

the operator, talking with Gwen by voice on the rig and by text from a phone or laptop at gwen.culture.dev; and culture-rules, the producer that enqueues distilled facts from Pocket recordings and the daily newspaper
both audiences have a surface: the operator a voice/text turn and the chat page, culture-rules the memory verbs with a documented record contract

Gwen answers a question about a Pocket recording or a newspaper item — spoken or typed — from her own memory, cites where the fact came from, and finds it by meaning in Hebrew rather than by an exact word; culture-rules feeds her through one verb; pocketsync can redirect pocketchat to gwen.culture.dev
the after-state is demonstrated with synthetic records only — no real recording or transcript enters the repo or a test

today the operator's recordings are reachable only through pocketchat, a second chat front with its own index, and Gwen's recall is keyword-only and blind to Hebrew morphology (#92 measured 0 of 24 recalls rendered in one session); one front with one memory is the point, and C3 says a recall that silently finds nothing is the worst outcome
the before numbers quoted are #92's, re-measured on this store by the success_signal measurement rather than restated

a synthetic pocket batch and a synthetic newspaper batch enqueued with `memory ingest --apply` are applied by a running daemon within 2 drain intervals, recalled in a text turn and cited with their source; 0 records lost across 100 interleaved ingest and remember writes
the drain is exercised by a test that interleaves CLI enqueues with daemon remember calls against a real files backend and counts every record afterwards
on Gwen's store, recall hit@5 and hit@1 and latency median/p90 are published for keyword+d5 versus gemma2-embed with cached vectors, with n stated and published whatever the numbers say
the measurement runs on a copy of the store, with reinforce=False, a labelled query set and the daemon's own recall path, and states n

on the public Host: 100% of requests without a valid Access JWT are refused (401/403), a valid operator JWT is admitted without the install secret, and an unreachable JWKS answers 503 — all under test with a locally signed RS256 key
the verifier's tests sign tokens with a locally generated RSA key and a fake JWKS fetch — no network in the suite

on the public Host a request admitted by Access JWT alone must also carry an allow-listed Origin or Sec-Fetch-Site: same-origin, because Cloudflare adds the assertion to any request carrying the CF_Authorization cookie, cross-site ones included; the guard's CSRF rule today fires only for a cookie-borne install secret
a cross-site POST to the chat route with a valid assertion and no allow-listed Origin is refused

the Access verifier admits only an sso identity whose email is on an explicit operator allow-list (EMBODIMENT_ACCESS_EMAILS); service tokens and any other email are refused even when signature, iss and aud are valid
a correctly signed token for the right audience but another email, or of kind service, is refused
an SSE stream admitted by Access is closed when its token's exp passes, so a revoked session cannot keep reading the transcript
an event stream opened with a token expiring in 2 s is closed by the server within one heartbeat after exp

the inbox trusts the local Unix account: any process running as the daemon's user can enqueue a batch and it is stamped added_by culture-rules; added_by records the channel, not an authenticated author
the inbox directory is 0700 and every queued batch file 0600, owned by the daemon's user, so only that account can enqueue

semantic recall makes no per-recall embed probe: the embedder's online state comes from the last real embed call and a background re-probe, so a recall costs one query embed plus cached-vector scoring
a semantic recall with every candidate cached makes exactly one embed request

semantic recall returns nothing when nothing is relevant: a minimum similarity, calibrated on the labelled set and published with its n, so unrelated memories (above all web-derived newspaper text) are not rendered into every turn
an unrelated query returns zero records under the calibrated threshold on the labelled set

every record lacking a cached vector — the 24 already in Gwen's store, and any written before the cache existed — is embedded by a bounded background backfill at start; the voice path never embeds an uncached candidate
after start against a store with N uncached records, all N gain vectors without a turn waiting on it
semantic recall is a configuration switch: keyword+d5 stays shipped as the fallback and as a one-flag rollback, and the recall mode in effect is in status()
setting the recall mode back to keyword restores today's behaviour on every existing memory test

the spool keeps no second copy of memory text: done/ keeps only a receipt (batch id, record ids, counts, hashes), failed/ keeps the reason and is purged after 7 days, and the vector cache is 0600 under the state dir, never committed, and drops an entry when its record is archived
after ingest then forget of a recording, no file under the state dir except the archived store record contains the recording's text or its vector

a recall that lands while the reply is still being spoken is used by a second completion for the not-yet-spoken remainder, given the sentences already spoken as context; the first completion's unspoken sentences are dropped, never spliced
with a slow fake recall that lands after sentence 1 of 3, sentence 1 plays as generated and sentences 2..n come from a second completion that saw the memory

a recall that lands after the reply has finished becomes at most one memory follow-up per turn: spoken only if it clears the relevance threshold (c52), only while nobody holds the floor, and only inside a window derived from the measured recall-arrival distribution; otherwise it is dropped and counted
a late recall arriving while the operator is speaking, or after the window, produces no audio and increments its own dropped counter
stop-and-restart is reserved for a memory that the already-spoken text is inconsistent with; it uses the same stop_playback path as barge-in and records why it restarted
a restart is recorded with a safe reason and never fires while the operator holds the floor

background recall is observable: status() counts recalls landed before the first sentence, during the reply, after it (follow-up), and dropped, with the arrival-time distribution; a turn that answered without memory because recall was late is not a degradation, but it is counted
every background recall increments exactly one of the four counters

the daemon-initiated follow-up is built as the general 'Gwen speaks without being spoken to' seam that #89 (job results) and #90 (chosen silence) also need, not a recall-only special case; the turn contract's never-silent rule (b4) does not apply to a dropped follow-up
the follow-up path has one entry point that a non-recall caller can use in a test
a typed turn answers on the page first, and a memory follow-up for it arrives as a later chat message on the same stream, never through the speaker
a text turn whose recall lands late shows two messages on the page and plays no audio

each of Gwen's messages on the chat page has a speak button: the daemon synthesises that message through the gateway's tts lane (/v1/audio/speech) behind a guarded route and returns the audio to the requesting browser, which plays it there — never through the room's speaker; the audio is never written to disk
pressing speak on a message produces audio in the browser and no call to the host endpoint's play()

the chat page can record audio in the browser or upload an audio file; the daemon transcribes it in memory through the gateway's stt lane (/v1/audio/transcriptions) and runs the transcript as a typed turn (text reply, c58); raw audio is never written to disk, and the upload is capped in bytes and duration
an upload over the cap is refused with 413 before transcription, and no audio byte reaches the state dir on any path

the chat page shows a speech-to-speech button that is disabled, with the reason shown, while the gateway serves no speech-to-speech role; the role is configured by name and never inferred from a model name; turning speech-to-speech on is not in this cycle
with no such role in GET /capabilities the button is disabled and says why

the not-yet list says what voice on the phone now is: recorded or uploaded clips and per-message playback are shipped; live realtime voice from the phone and speech-to-speech stay not-yet, with tests/test_release_docs.py updated to match
the release-docs test pins 'phone voice' to the live-realtime meaning and passes

tasks.summary: Ingest contract: source registry, record validation, caps and charset-safe stored ids
acceptance_criteria: owns embodiment/ingest/__init__.py, embodiment/ingest/contract.py and tests/test_ingest_contract.py only

a registry holds exactly two sources, pocket and newspaper, each with its allowlisted types, id prefix, required provenance fields and per-record and per-batch caps; any other source is refused with a CliError-shaped error naming the registry
validate_batch(lines) validates every record before returning anything and returns either the whole stamped batch or one refusal with the first failing line number
stamping forces visibility private, the shared ingest scope and added_by culture-rules whatever the input says
wire ids such as `pocket:<rec>:<kind>:<n>` map deterministically to a stored id inside HEADER_LABEL_CHARSET, and the mapping is stable across runs
tasks.instruction: Pure module: no IO, no model call, no clock (pass dates in). Map wire ids with a fixed scheme such as replacing ':' with '.', and reject inputs that would collide after mapping. Keep the wire id in metadata. No new dependency (tests/test_zero_deps.py must pass unchanged). Synthetic data only - the repo is public; never copy a record from Gwen's real store. Degrade, never raise; every degradation is recorded (C3).

tasks.summary: Ingest spool: atomic enqueue, ordered inbox, receipts-only done/, purged failed/
acceptance_criteria: owns embodiment/ingest/spool.py and tests/test_ingest_spool.py only
enqueue writes a temp file and renames it into a 0700 inbox as a 0600 file with a sortable name; a refused batch leaves the inbox directory byte-identical
batches list in enqueue order; mark_done keeps only a receipt (batch id, record ids, counts, hashes), never record text; mark_failed keeps the reason and failed/ entries older than 7 days are purged
status() reports pending, done and failed counts and the oldest pending age, and works with no daemon running
tasks.instruction: Reuse daemon/state.py's helpers by importing them (resolve_state_dir, the private dir/file modes, the atomic writer); if one is private, add a public alias there in this task and nothing else in state.py. Forget requests are batches of their own kind in the same queue, so ordering holds across ingest and forget. No new dependency (tests/test_zero_deps.py must pass unchanged). Synthetic data only - the repo is public; never copy a record from Gwen's real store. Degrade, never raise; every degradation is recorded (C3).

tasks.summary: Cited stdlib Cloudflare Access verifier with an operator email allow-list
acceptance_criteria: owns embodiment/http/access.py and tests/test_http_access.py only
the module header cites pocketsync/web/access.py, culture-rules culture_rules/auth/access.py and culture-nodes internal/auth/verifier.go, and says this copy is owned by embodiment

a token signed with a locally generated RSA key and served by a fake JWKS fetch verifies; bad signature, wrong iss, wrong aud, expired, not-yet-valid, unknown kid and malformed each fail with their own safe reason
only an sso identity whose email is in the configured allow-list is admitted; a service token or another email is refused even when the signature is valid
an unreachable JWKS yields an unavailable result distinct from a refusal; config is the all-or-nothing pair EMBODIMENT_ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN + EMBODIMENT_ACCESS_AUD plus EMBODIMENT_ACCESS_EMAILS
tasks.instruction: Copy pocketsync/pocketsync/web/access.py (326 lines) and adapt; standard library only, urllib not httpx. Its tests (pocketsync tests/test_web_access.py, 26 tests) are the model for yours. Return a result the guard's AssertionVerifier seam can take (guard.py:296-324); never raise out of verify. No new dependency (tests/test_zero_deps.py must pass unchanged). Synthetic data only - the repo is public; never copy a record from Gwen's real store. Degrade, never raise; every degradation is recorded (C3).

acceptance_criteria: owns embodiment/vectors.py and tests/test_vectors.py only
the cache is a 0600 file under a given dir, keyed by text hash + embedding model; an entry for another model is never returned; drop(record_id) removes an entry

the client embeds through the gateway's /v1/embeddings with model gemma2-embed named by role, and online state comes from the last real call plus a bounded background re-probe; a recall-path call makes exactly one request
an unreachable embedder is reported as offline with a reason, never raised
tasks.instruction: Probe findings: one call through the proxy to orin costs 158-210 ms; eidetic's no-prompt payload is accepted (cos 0.901 related vs 0.715 unrelated, n=1); the lane accepts Retrieval-query / Retrieval-document prompt names and refuses 'Query'. Key via EMBODIMENT_GATEWAY_KEY as the daemon already does; tests use a fake transport. No new dependency (tests/test_zero_deps.py must pass unchanged). Synthetic data only - the repo is public; never copy a record from Gwen's real store. Degrade, never raise; every degradation is recorded (C3).

tasks.summary: RoomMemory write side: two scopes, supersede flip, forget by source, forget-tool isolation
acceptance_criteria: owns embodiment/memory.py write-side methods and tests/test_memory_ingest.py only
recall reads the gwen scope and the ingest scope inside one deadline, and no other scope
ingest_records writes one record per lock hold, and a record carrying supersedes flips the superseded record's lifecycle before returning; a recall after it never returns the superseded record
forget_source(source, source_id) archives every ingest record with that metadata.recording_id or issue id by enumerating the scope, and no other; forget_ids archives exact ids
a record whose text hash collides with an existing record is reported as collapsed, never silently dropped; the forget tool's id path cannot archive an ingest-scope record
tasks.instruction: continuity._build_record already accepts supersedes/lifecycle/scope (continuity.py:690-734); RoomMemory._build does not emit them (memory.py:1549-1572). The files backend drops same-hash records on a new id (data_refinery files.py:53-58): detect it before the write. Keep every write behind the existing executor and MAX_INFLIGHT gate. No new dependency (tests/test_zero_deps.py must pass unchanged). Synthetic data only - the repo is public; never copy a record from Gwen's real store. Degrade, never raise; every degradation is recorded (C3).

tasks.summary: CLI memory noun: ingest, ingest --status, forget, overview
acceptance_criteria: owns embodiment/cli/_commands/memory.py, its registration in embodiment/cli/__init__.py, the memory entries in embodiment/explain/catalog.py, overview.py's verb list and tests/test_cli_memory.py only
memory ingest --file is a dry run unless --apply, takes --json and --state-dir, and exits 0 / 1 with error + hint on refusal; forget takes --source + --source-id or --id
the verbs succeed under env {PATH, LANG}, stdin closed, a temp cwd, an absolute --file and --state-dir
teken cli doctor . --strict and tests/test_cli_introspection.py pass
tasks.instruction: Follow the nested-noun precedent in cli/_commands/cli.py:34-54 (parser_class=type(p)); add memory overview because the rubric's overview_cli_noun_exists check needs it. The verbs only enqueue; they never touch the store. Report daemon liveness from lifecycle.status() separately from the enqueue result. No new dependency (tests/test_zero_deps.py must pass unchanged). Synthetic data only - the repo is public; never copy a record from Gwen's real store. Degrade, never raise; every degradation is recorded (C3).

tasks.summary: Guard: Access JWT replaces the secret on the public Host, with CSRF and 503
acceptance_criteria: owns embodiment/http/guard.py and tests/test_http_guard.py only
with the Access env unset, every existing guard test passes unchanged and the public Host is refused as today
on the public Host a valid assertion admits a request without the install secret; loopback and LAN still require the secret
an Access-admitted request without an allow-listed Origin or Sec-Fetch-Site: same-origin is refused; an unavailable JWKS answers 503 with its own code
tasks.instruction: Today _check runs Host, Origin, secret, then the assertion (guard.py:541-551) and _check_assertion hard-codes 401. Add a status to the refusal path for unavailable. Extend the cookie CSRF rule (guard.py:577-611) to the assertion path: Cloudflare adds the assertion to cross-site requests too. No new dependency (tests/test_zero_deps.py must pass unchanged). Synthetic data only - the repo is public; never copy a record from Gwen's real store. Degrade, never raise; every degradation is recorded (C3).

tasks.summary: Dashboard chat view with cited sources
acceptance_criteria: owns web/src/components/Chat.tsx, Chat.test.tsx, web/src/api/chat.ts, chat.test.ts and the Chat mount in web/src/App.tsx only
a message posts to /api/chat and the reply and every source render as text nodes with dir=auto; a static test forbids innerHTML, dangerouslySetInnerHTML and insertAdjacentHTML under web/src
a source shows its provenance (recording title, date, mm:ss; or issue date, section, link as plain text) and is fenced as untrusted
a later memory follow-up for a typed turn arrives on the event stream and shows as a second message; on the public Host the page does not ask for the install secret
tasks.instruction: Contract: POST /api/chat {message} -> {reply, sources:[{source, title, date, start, end, section, link, text}]}; follow-ups arrive as SSE kind reply with turn_serial. Reuse Transcript.tsx's dir=auto pattern (Transcript.tsx:28). React 18 only; no new npm dependency. No new dependency (tests/test_zero_deps.py must pass unchanged). Synthetic data only - the repo is public; never copy a record from Gwen's real store. Degrade, never raise; every degradation is recorded (C3).

tasks.summary: Render provenance through the single recall funnel
acceptance_criteria: owns render_recalled and its helpers in embodiment/memory.py and tests/test_memory.py only
an ingest record renders its provenance (title, date, mm:ss; issue date, section, link) as neutralised quoted data inside the fence
the fuzz generator produces hostile values for every new rendered field and test_no_generated_record_escapes_the_fence passes; the one-sanitiser AST test passes
a scripted turn whose recalled record says to call remember or forget executes no tool call
tasks.instruction: Every new field goes through _label/_neutralise with a charset or is quoted as body text (memory.py:2021-2134); extend HEADER_PATTERN if a header changes. The fuzz class is TestTheFenceHoldsUnderFuzzing (tests/test_memory.py:1233). No new dependency (tests/test_zero_deps.py must pass unchanged). Synthetic data only - the repo is public; never copy a record from Gwen's real store. Degrade, never raise; every degradation is recorded (C3).

tasks.summary: HTTP routes: chat, speak, clip upload, and SSE close at token expiry
acceptance_criteria: owns embodiment/http/server.py and tests/test_http_server.py only
POST /api/chat, /api/speak and /api/clip are guarded control routes with bounded bodies; a clip over its byte cap is 413 before any callable runs
a slow callable answers 503 with a reason inside its own bound, never a hung request
an event stream admitted by an assertion closes within one heartbeat after the token's exp
tasks.instruction: Add Controls callables beside start_voice/stop_voice/set_mute/status (server.py:354-371) and routes in _CONTROL_ROUTES (server.py:275); controls run on the bounded pool via call_control (server.py:1130) - give chat its own longer bound. No new dependency (tests/test_zero_deps.py must pass unchanged). Synthetic data only - the repo is public; never copy a record from Gwen's real store. Degrade, never raise; every degradation is recorded (C3).

tasks.summary: The drain: daemon-side single writer for the spool, with newspaper retention
acceptance_criteria: owns embodiment/daemon/drain.py and tests/test_daemon_drain.py only

drain_once(budget) applies whole batches in enqueue order, one record write per lock hold, and moves each to done/ or failed/ exactly once; killing it between records and re-running completes the batch idempotently
applying the same batch twice leaves the scope file identical apart from store-owned timestamps
a newspaper item is recallable 29 days after its issue date and archived by 31, with an injected clock
tasks.instruction: Callable from DaemonApp.pump (app.py:1404-1418) with a time budget; never block the 0.5 s heartbeat. Per-record failures use new app-ingest-* codes through the daemon's _record path (app.py:1268-1302), passed in as a callback. No new dependency (tests/test_zero_deps.py must pass unchanged). Synthetic data only - the repo is public; never copy a record from Gwen's real store. Degrade, never raise; every degradation is recorded (C3).

tasks.summary: Semantic recall over cached vectors, with a threshold, backfill and keyword rollback
acceptance_criteria: owns the recall-mode code in embodiment/memory.py and tests/test_memory.py recall cases only
a semantic recall with every candidate cached makes exactly one embed request and no probe
a query below the similarity threshold returns zero records; the threshold is a config value
a bounded background backfill embeds every uncached record at start and the recall path never embeds a candidate
recall mode keyword restores today's behaviour on every existing memory test; an unreachable embedder demotes to keyword with a recorded degradation and status() names the embedder role

risks.text: senses (the speaker) is not served on this rig (frame park v4, served from thor once deployed); t18's question generation and any live check wait until a chat role reports ready
the stt lane's accepted formats are unverified against browser recordings (webm/opus, mp4/aac); a transcode step would need a dependency approval (tests/test_zero_deps.py)
per-turn embeds add load on orin next to pocketsync's own embeds; unmeasured
the second completion for an unspoken remainder adds latency nobody has measured; the arrival counters and t18 publish it

sibling work, proposed only through the communicate skill with the operator's go-ahead: pocketsync's landed/deleted/merged events and its refused prompt_name 'Query'; culture-rules' distil step, newspaper rule and file-writing action
memory.py is touched by t5, t9 and t12 in sequence; the chain is deliberate (one file) and lengthens the critical path

forget_source's deadline is per step, so on a slow-but-not-hung store one call takes up to (1+N) x deadline and a drain pass overruns its 0.25 s budget; Spool.pending() parses every inbox batch per pass, so a large backlog overruns too. Mitigation in t16: run drain_once off the pump thread (its own worker), so the heartbeat never waits on it; a total deadline in memory.forget_source and a head-only spool listing are follow-ups

the newspaper retention ledger (<spool>/newspaper-retention.json) is the only index of issue dates; if it is lost or malformed, issues already in the store are never aged out (recorded as app-ingest-ledger, not rebuilt) until a public ingest-scope enumeration exists

forget archives a record and drops its vector, but a private per-session transcript log (sessions/*.jsonl, 0600, size-bounded) that quoted the fact keeps that sentence; operator chose to document it and redact logs on forget in a follow-up
